title: Custom domain, TLS ask and go-live (M5 features)
summary: With the milestone switches on, staff give an OTA a plan with live mode and a custom domain; the owner adds a domain and sees its DNS records and checks; Caddy's TLS ask is tried by hand; the go-live page lists the preconditions, which are met one by one until the OTA switches to live.
prerequisites: In `platform/backend/.env.local`: `FEATURE_CUSTOM_DOMAINS=true`, `FEATURE_LIVE_SWITCH=true`, `FEATURE_SETTLEMENTS=true` (and `FEATURE_OWN_AMADEUS` stays false); restart the platform backend, portal and admin.
The owner has MFA on ([[journey:signup-and-provision]], step "mfa"); the platform admin is signed in.
DNS verification cannot succeed locally (the domain is not yours and the public resolvers do not know it): expect the domain to stay pending with a stored reason.

steps.title: Give the OTA a plan with live mode and one custom domain
steps.actions: On **Plans** create a non-public plan (for example code `live_test`, EUR, a monthly price, limits: custom domains 1, live mode on). On **Subscriptions** open the OTA's manual subscription and move it to that plan with status *active* and a reason.
steps.expect: The plan is listed with 0 OTAs, then 1. The subscription edit asks only for a reason (no step-up: `adminUpdateManualSubscription` is not a step-up operation), then shows the new plan and status *Active*.
steps.data: `platform.plans` new row (`limits` jsonb with `customDomains: 1`, `liveMode: true`); `platform.subscriptions` (`billing_provider = manual`, `active`); `platform.tenants.plan_code` updated; audit `plan.created`, `subscription.manually_updated`; `vx:invalidate {type: "tenant"}`.

steps.title: Add a custom domain
steps.actions: On **Domains** the Velexis address `<key>.ota.example.com` is listed. In **Add a custom domain** type `TRAVEL.EXAMPLE.NET` and press **Add domain**. Try `<other>.ota.example.com`, an IP address and `github.io` too.
steps.expect: *travel.example.net was added*: the domain is stored in lower case and shown pending with its DNS records: `TXT _velexis.travel.example.net = vx-verify-…` and either `CNAME travel.example.net → <key>.ota.example.com` or `A` to `STOREFRONT_IPV4` (`203.0.113.10` locally; also `AAAA` `2001:db8::10` while `STOREFRONT_IPV6` is set); a 72-hour deadline (*Verify by*) and **Check now**. Velexis hosts, IPs and shared suffixes are refused with *Enter a valid public domain name…*.
steps.data: `SELECT hostname, kind, verification_status, verification_token, is_primary FROM platform.tenant_domains WHERE tenant_id = 'ten_…';` → `custom`, `pending`.

steps.title: Check now (and the scheduled checks)
steps.actions: Press **Check now**; press it again at once; wait for the worker's 5-minute `domains.verify_pending` run.
steps.expect: The last check time and a short reason appear (for example a missing TXT record or a DNS timeout); the second click within a minute is limited. The domain stays *pending* until its deadline, then *failed* with an e-mail to the owners.
steps.data: `tenant_domains.verification_status`, plus the last check time and error columns; jobs on `vx:platform-domains:*`.

steps.title: Ask the TLS question Caddy asks
steps.expect: `200` for the sub-domain of a provisioning, active or suspended OTA; `404` for the pending custom domain and for an unknown host. (On the VM Caddy asks this before obtaining a certificate; `/internal/*` is blocked publicly.)

steps.title: Staff view of domains
steps.actions: Open **Domains**; filter; press **Re-check** (confirm), then **Remove** with a reason.
steps.expect: The dashboard counts pending custom domains; Re-check queues the DNS check at once; Remove asks for a reason, removes the domain and e-mails the owners ("`<host>` was removed from `<OTA>`") without the reason.

steps.title: The go-live page lists what is missing
steps.actions: Open **Go live**. Press **Go live**, confirm *Switch your storefront to live?* with **Go live**, then the step-up (**Confirm it is you**, a TOTP code) if your last code is older than 15 minutes.
steps.expect: "What going live needs" lists six items with links: live Amadeus, live payments, payout account, plan with live mode, subscription, two-factor sign-in (Done from your account; the others *Checked when you go live* until tried). Going live with items missing shows *Your OTA cannot go live yet* and "N requirements are missing, so nothing has changed", marking exactly `details.missing` of `422 LIVE_PRECONDITIONS_UNMET` as *Missing*; nothing changes.

steps.title: Payout account (Velexis mode)
steps.actions: Enter a holder, the bank's country and currency and the IBAN registry's Norwegian example `NO93 8601 1117 947` with BIC `DNBANOKK` (not a real account); save and confirm the step-up. As platform admin, verify the payout account on the OTA's page.
steps.expect: Saved, shown masked (last 4 only) and *pending review*; after the admin's review, *verified*.

steps.title: Live Amadeus access
steps.actions: As owner request live access on the portal's **Amadeus** page. As admin: enter the Velexis **live** Amadeus account on **Amadeus → Accounts** (the stub accepts any client id and secret, development only), add live offices to its pool, then assign one to the request from the dashboard.
steps.expect: The request appears on the admin dashboard; after assignment the OTA's live connection is active and the owner gets "Live Amadeus access is ready for `<OTA>`".

steps.title: Go live
steps.actions: Back on **Go live**, press **Go live**, confirm the dialog and the step-up.
steps.expect: *Your storefront is live* with *Live since* and the live storefront link. Within 60 seconds the storefront drops the *Test mode* note; the API keys page gains a *Live keys* tab; the console offers the TEST / LIVE switch to roles other than viewer (MFA required for a live OTA's console).
steps.data: `platform.tenants.storefront_environment = live`, `live_enabled_at` set; live payment connection copied in Velexis mode; audit row; `vx:invalidate {type: "tenant"}`.
